_meta.description: Single source of truth for the Detection Atlas and Appendix C. Every number is copied from the cited source; nothing is re-measured.
_meta.fields: name, family, tier, org, year, params_m, gflops, input, coco_ap (val2017 AP50:95 unless note says otherwise), latency_ms, latency_hw, pretrain, license, nms (true = needs NMS; false = NMS-free; 'opt' = both heads), source, note
_meta.tiers: mcu | tiny | edge | realtime | large | open-vocab | mllm | classic
_meta.latency_rule: Only rows whose latency_hw is exactly 'T4 TRT FP16' are plotted together. Other hardware is listed but never mixed on one axis.
